product_one_liner.value: Appspace gives organizations a unified workplace platform for employee communications, intranet and mobile content, digital signage, room reservations, and visitor management.

employee_band.notes: Company-size band reported on Appspace’s LinkedIn profile.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed index presents workplace-strategy and product-oriented content, not two qualifying engineering-authored posts about building Appspace.

public_docs.notes: The public Knowledge Center contains multiple product, device-configuration, and workspace-reservation guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job board lists seven openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, and Gemini Enterprise are named as supported AI connections.
model_provider.notes: These are optional connections; the page does not identify the provider or model behind Appspace’s built-in default.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the claims named on the cited page; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than an independent certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest known investment was announced September 21, 2023, from Accel-KKR; the amount was not disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest known investment, September 21, 2023, predates the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current board lists a Business Development Representative and several Account Executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The July 10, 2026 Dorado announcement expanded Insights Assistant conversational analytics across digital signage, devices, reservations, visitor management, and intranet.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On March 19, 2026, Appspace announced Eric Daggett as Chief Sales Officer and Dan Ward as Chief Technology Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Named in Appspace’s Business Development Representative posting.
